Steph / Ben —

Quick internal note with recommended pricing constructs for Lumina (based on the RFP volumes):

- Audit logs:
  - Option A (pass-through): $0.02/GB/month for retention beyond 90 days + $0.005/GB ingest.
  - Option B (managed): $8k/month for unlimited ingest up to 15TB with 12-month commit (favored for predictable spend).

- KMS / HSM:
  - Seat model: $3,500/seat/month (dedicated HSM) — strong for customers needing FIPS/HSM-backed keys.
  - Throughput model: $0.0004/key-op (pay-for-ops) with predictable ceiling for high-volume use.

- Residency & egress:
  - Residency surcharge: 8–12% uplift for EU-resident dedicated infra.
  - Egress: pass-throughed at actual cloud egress rates, with an optional capped egress bundle if they commit.

Crediting approaches to recommend to Lumina:
1) Implementation credit: one-time credit applied to first invoice (covers evidence delivery).
2) Amortized credit: convert implementation cost into monthly credit over 12 months if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity.
3) Milestone credit: 50% on SOC2 evidence delivery + 50% on production activation.

Pilot path (min friction):
- 3-month pilot with a reduced residency surcharge (50% of list) + implementation credit of up to $25k applied if they sign a 12-mo commit.
- Require a short Statement of Work for evidence deliverables (we can attach a light SOW) — evidence matrix should be explicit to avoid rework.

Questions for Steph / Ben before we send to customer:
- Floor for HSM seat concession (we generally don’t go below $2k/seat/month without 24-mo commit).
- Are we prepared to cap the egress for the pilot at a blended rate to make economics simpler?

If we agree, I can draft a concise counterproposal PDF and an evidence-matrix spreadsheet for Lumina.

- Karthik
Director, Pricing and Commercial Strategy

Thanks for the RFP. Per Stephanie's note, attached is a concise counterproposal and an evidence matrix that maps each item you listed to how Redwood will deliver it and the proposed commercial treatment. High level:

1) Pilot proposal (3 months) — objective: validate integration, prove evidence handoff, and baseline token throughput.
   - Residency surcharge: 6% (50% off standard 12% list for pilot)
   - HSM: temporary access via shared HSM pool at $1,800/seat/month for pilot (capped to 2 seats)
   - Audit logs: retained for 90 days free for pilot; additional retention charged at $0.015/GB/month
   - Implementation/evidence: $18,000 one-time implementation fee, OR we can amortize as a $1,500/month credit over 12 months if you sign a 12-month committed plan within 30 days of pilot close.

2) Production conversion — if Lumina converts to a 12-month reserved capacity within 30 days of pilot close we will:
   - Apply the $18k implementation fee as a $18k credit spread evenly over the first 12 invoices (amortized credit).
   - Offer a 10% committed usage discount on hosted tokens + a 20% discount on HSM seat pricing for the first 6 months.

3) Evidence delivery — we've attached an evidence-matrix (evidence-matrix.xlsx) that lists deliverables (SOC2 report, KMS integration proof, audit log export sample) and the expected delivery date relative to the pilot start. We propose milestone credit split: 50% when evidence is delivered, 50% at production activation.
